Tafel II.

  • Fig. 1. Astur cruentus Gould (Mus. Godeffroy) Valid name Accipiter fasciatus (Vigors and Horsfield, 1827)
  • Fig. 2. Platycercus splendens Peale Valid name Prosopeia splendens (Peale, 1848)
  • Fig. 3. Ptilinopus fasciatus Peale Valid name Ptilinopus porphyraceus (Temminck, 1821)
  • Fig 4. Chrysoena luteovirens Hombr Valid name Ptilinopus luteovirens Hombron & Jacquinot, 1841
  • Fig. 5. Megapodius Pritchardi Gray. Valid name Megapodius pritchardii Gray, 1864
